add-executor-peers.description: Add sharp and crypto-js to devDependencies (no longer auto-installed peers)

angular-release-target.description: Give generated Angular apps a real Angular build target and move the pipeline to release

add-lint-dependencies.description: Add the ESLint packages (and Angular lint packages for Angular 15 workspaces) that are missing

add-lib-build-dependencies.description: Add the PostCSS packages (and ng-packagr) that buildable/publishable Angular libs need to build

fix-lint-script.description: Replace the self-calling "lint": "npm run lint" script written by earlier pstack new with nx run-many -t lint

prepush-audit-warn-only.description: Make the pre-push dependency audit warn-only (secret scan first and still blocking) and add a strict check:audit script

add-lint-staged-config.description: Add the lint-staged config that the pre-commit hook of pstack new workspaces runs (it was missing, so commits failed)

add-csp-nonce-import.description: Import the library's CSP nonce patch first in main.ts of Angular and Ionic apps (local nonce patch imports are kept)

env-encryption-config.description: Move env encryption settings into nx.json (pstack.envEncryption, mode listed with the keys of tools/config/encrypt-keys.json) and ignore .env.local

env-encryption-key-sources.description: Rename nx.json pstack.envEncryption.keySource to keySources (aes-gcm key factors)

release-hardening.description: Turn on the leak check, source-map guard, comment stripping and console removal for UAT/PROD release configurations, remove the replaced harden option, add terser

app-clean-and-port.description: Add a clean target to apps without one and give apps that all served on port 4200 distinct dev-server ports

quality-checks.description: Add typecheck targets (tsc --noEmit) and the CI typecheck step, and the import/no-unresolved and unused-imports ESLint rules as warnings

plugin-repo-dev.description: Point GitHub workflows that name the plugin's earlier repo at its current repo

sharp-security-update.description: Move sharp to ^0.35.5, the first version without the bundled libvips, libheif and librsvg vulnerabilities

flutter-web-platform.description: Add the web/ folder (index.html, manifest.json) that flutter build web needs to Flutter apps generated without one

github-actions-node24.description: Move GitHub workflows to the Node 24 action versions (checkout, setup-node, cache, nx-set-shas v5; create-pull-request v8)

env-import-alias.description: Import env files through the @env/* tsconfig alias instead of a relative path into environments/ (refused by @nx/enforce-module-boundaries from Nx 18 on)

env-files-layout.description: Move per-environment files into environments/<project>/: the .htaccess an app's build copied becomes htaccess.<env> per release env (htaccess: false when it had none), Flutter env JSON moves to environment.<env>.json, and Flutter targets on tools/scripts/flutter/flutter-build.js move to the plugin executor

lint-staged-eslint-resolve.description: Fix the lint-staged ESLint script so commits with staged TypeScript files find ESLint 8 and later again (it resolved bin/eslint.js, which ESLint no longer exports)

nx-analytics-off.description: Set nx.json "analytics": false when the workspace has not answered Nx's usage-data prompt, so Nx 22 no longer stops to ask

application-builder-flat-output.description: Set outputPath.browser to "" on application-builder targets a release target builds, so release builds have no browser/ folder
